title: MSI RTX 3060 Ti Review & Gaming Benchmarks - The Ultimate Mid Range Graphics Card for PC Gamers?
description:
In this video we take a look at the MSI RTX 3060 TI Gaming X Trio graphics card. This new NVidia graphics card will be targeting the mid-range market and is the 4th graphics card to be introduced into the RTX 30 series. Is this the ultimate mid range graphics card that PC gamers have been waiting for? Well all of that will be answered in this review and performance analysis.
